encounters.notes: Outer Midway: sticky ash clings to Crono; polish it off.

Puppet stage: squash the inflating dummy with a BLUNT hit; sword hits on the stringers count as thread cuts. Six cuts collapse the stage.

One shared 6-plate shield across the whole choir; MYCELIA silences the mouths.
Hall of Mirrors: hecklers steal BP every 10 s and turn invulnerable if ignored for 15 s.
Inner Big Top: the elite mimic is Break-immune until its three spring puppets are cut; holds a Charred Laurel fragment.
Puppet stage: Cyrus's Phase 1 cast as a regular bill, two dummies, a barker and a heckler.
